headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 10, 2026**
article:
The Seattle Mariners secured a thrilling 6-5 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Randy Arozarena leading the offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance. The Los Angeles Dodgers dominated the Pittsburgh Pirates 12-3, with Andy Pages leading the offense and Paul Skenes pitching 6.0 strong innings. The Tampa Bay Rays took down the Boston Red Sox in a thrilling finish, securing a 4-3 victory with Nick Martinez earning the win.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, affecting their team's availability. Oneil Cruz has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to left hand fourth and fifth metacarpal non-displaced fractures. The Los Angeles Angels have placed Sebastián Rivero on the 10-day injured list with a left hamate fracture and Jack Kochanowicz on the 60-day injured list with right elbow inflammation. Matt Brash has been placed on the 15-day injured list with a right lat strain, and Tyler Gilbert has been placed on the 15-day injured list with left shoulder impingement.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place. The Detroit Tigers acquired Jacob Waguespack from the Milwaukee Brewers. The Pittsburgh Pirates traded Carson Fulmer to the Seattle Mariners for cash. The Tampa Bay Rays traded Raynel Delgado to the Houston Astros for cash. The Arizona Diamondbacks traded Taylor Rashi to the Minnesota Twins for cash. The Texas Rangers traded Richie Martin Jr. to the Colorado Rockies for cash.

top_news.title: **Mariners Take Down Orioles in Thrilling 6-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners edged out the Baltimore Orioles in a close game, securing a 6-5 win. Randy Arozarena led the Mariners' offense with a strong 3-hit, 1-home run performance, driving in 3 runs.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Dominate Pirates in 12-3 Rout**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers secured a convincing 12-3 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Andy Pages leading the offense and Paul Skenes pitching a strong 6.0 innings.

top_news.title: **Rays Edge Red Sox 4-3 in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a 4-3 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Nick Martinez earning the win. Marcelo Mayer led the Red Sox offense with a 2-RBI performance, including a crucial double that scored two runs.

top_news.title: **Tigers Rout Twins 10-4**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers dominated the Minnesota Twins, securing a 10-4 victory. Dillon Dingler led the Tigers' offense with four hits, including two home runs and four RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Red Sox 7-5**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a 7-5 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Drew Rasmussen leading the pitching effort. Impact hitters for the Rays included Yandy Díaz and Taylor Walls, while Cedric Mullins and Caleb Durbin contributed for the Red Sox.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Guardians 8-4**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured an 8-4 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Carlos Rodón leading the way on the mound. Impact hitters for the Yankees included José Caballero and Angel Martínez, while Paul Goldschmidt and Trent Grisham had notable performances for the Guardians.

top_news.title: **Pirates' Cruz Sidelined with Hand Injuries**
top_news.summary: Pittsburgh Pirates center fielder Oneil Cruz has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to non-displaced fractures in his left hand's fourth and fifth metacarpal bones. The injury occurred on June 8, 2026.

top_news.title: **Waguespack Joins Tigers Roster**
top_news.summary: Jacob Waguespack has been traded to the Detroit Tigers. The right-handed pitcher was previously with the Milwaukee Brewers.
